description: This file defines the SQSAdapterFactory class, which implements the IQueueAdapterFactory interface for creating and managing SQS-based queue adapters in an Orleans streaming environment. It includes methods for initializing the factory, creating adapters and caches, and handling delivery failure policies.

classes.name: SQSAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing SQS-based queue adapters in Orleans streaming; implements initialization, creation, and configuration of adapters and associated components.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory and sets a default stream failure handler if none is provided.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the SQSAdapter configured with the factory's options and settings.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the adapter cache used by this factory.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Provides the stream queue mapper instance used for mapping stream identifiers to queue addresses.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns a task that resolves to the delivery failure handler for a specified queue ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate an SQSAdapterFactory via dependency injection, configuring it with options based on the provided service provider and name, and then initializing it.
